Hi Rafael / Marissa,

We received the invoice you issued for March usage but it’s missing our PO number (GF-4217) and the VAT registration detail on the header. Our AP team can’t post the invoice until both are present.

Two quick asks:
- Can you re-issue the invoice with PO GF-4217 and the VAT reg no. on the VAT line?
- How do you prefer to deliver invoices going forward — email copies, or provisioning Greenfield on your billing portal (we prefer portal if it can send an email copy to accounts-payable@greenfield.ai)?

I’m attaching our VAT certificate for reference. Also please confirm if you can send consolidated invoices monthly instead of multiple small ones — that would help our remittance flow.

Thanks,

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and the VAT cert. Happy to get this straightened out.

Plan: I’ll re-issue a corrected invoice that includes PO GF-4217 and an explicit VAT registration line. We can set you up in our billing portal to deliver invoices automatically and also send an email copy to accounts-payable@greenfield.ai (that’s the usual configuration we do for customers with AP automation).

Questions for you so we don’t have to loop back:
- Confirm billing contact: accounts-payable@greenfield.ai (will we also send a copy to your finance manager at lina.torres@greenfield.ai?)
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoice preferred? (You mentioned that — we can consolidate to one monthly invoice for recurring usage + any one-off charges.)
- Payment terms: is NET30 ok?

I attached a draft with the PO and VAT line added — please review and I’ll publish the final PDF from the portal.
